title: Slovakian Amazake Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish with a twist, featuring amazake-infused dumplings, served in a flavorful broth.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, combine vegetable broth, onion, caraway seeds, and salt.
2. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
3. In a separate bowl, mix together Slovakian dumpling mix and amazake.
4. Add the dumpling mixture to the simmering broth, and cook for 10-12 minutes.
5. Stir in sour cream, and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and additional amazake if desired.
